programme.title: PGA AUSTRALIA /26 - Australian Open Final Round
programme.desc: Australian Open Final Round. The 2025 Australian Open concludes from the iconic Royal Melbourne Golf Club.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1980: Greg Norman's First Aus Open Win
programme.desc: 1980: Greg Norman's First Aus Open Win. The Lakes Golf Club: Greg Norman, a young Queenslander with the world at his feet, took another step along the road to golfing greatness by winning his first Australian Open in 1980. He would later go on to win five at this event.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1984: Tom Watson Australian Open Triumph
programme.desc: 1984: Tom Watson Australian Open Triumph. Royal Melbourne: Tom Watson triumphs in the playoff to become the fifth American to win this Tournament.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1985: Greg Norman Wins Historic Aus Open
programme.desc: 1985: Greg Norman Wins Historic Aus Open. Royal Melbourne: Going into the final round there wasa four-way tie for the lead, but Greg Norman thundered to victory. Norman becomes fourth player to win both the Australian PGA and the Australian Open in the same year.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1987: Greg Norman Makes Aus Open History
programme.desc: 1987: Greg Norman Makes Aus Open History. Royal Melbourne: In spectacular style, Greg Norman absolutely decimated the field at the Australian Open by a whopping 10 strokes. That winning margin was also the largest in the history of the event.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1995: Greg Norman Wins Fourth Aus Open
programme.desc: 1995: Greg Norman Wins Fourth Aus Open. Kingston Heath, Melbourne: In tricky wind conditions, the World No. 1 Greg Norman holed a 40-foot birdie putt off the 17th green to set up a two-shot victory to win his fourth title in this tournament.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1999: Aaron Baddeley's Aus Open Ascent
programme.desc: 1999: Aaron Baddeley's Aus Open Ascent. Royal Syndey: Three weeks after he completed his year 12 exams, Aaron Baddeley went and won an Australian Open at 18 years of age. He became the first amateur since Bruce Devlin in 1960 to win the national Open.

programme.title: PGA AUSTRALIA /26 - Australian Open Final Round
programme.desc: Australian Open Final Round. The 2025 Australian Open concludes from the iconic Royal Melbourne Golf Club.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2011: Greg Chalmers Wins Second Aus Open
programme.desc: 2011: Greg Chalmers Wins Second Aus Open. The Lakes, Sydney: Australian left-hander Greg Chalmers held his nerve to win the Australian Open for the second time in his career, 13 years after his first win. He held off a late charge by John Senden and Tiger Woods to claim victory.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2013: Rory McIlroy Aus Open Knockout Win
programme.desc: 2013: Rory McIlroy Aus Open Knockout Win. Royal Sydney: With the biggest crowds in years congregating around the 18th green, Rory McIlroy made a birdie at the final hole to stop Adam Scott from completing the Triple Crown in 2013.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2015: Matt Jones Soars in Aus Open Win
programme.desc: 2015: Matt Jones Soars in Aus Open Win. Australian Golf Club, Sydney: Matt Jones survived a nerve-jangling final round to outlast world No.1 Jordan Spieth and a bolting Adam Scott to win the Australian Open.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2016: Speith's Second Aus Open Win
programme.desc: 2016: Speith's Second Aus Open Win. Royal Sydney Golf Club: Jordan Speith squeezes into a three-way play-off with Australians Ashley Hall and Cameron Smith, then duly banked an uphill 15-footer for birdie to win a gripping tournament.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2017: Australian Open Men's
programme.desc: 2017: Australian Open Men's. Australian Golf Club: Just 24-years-old at the time, then rising star Cam Smith claims the 2017 Australian PGA Championship in a playoff thriller.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2019: Australian Open Men's
programme.desc: 2019: Australian Open Men's. Australian Golf Club: In a field that included high profle players such as Adam Scott and Sergio Garcia, it was one shot by Matt Jones that saw him win the Australian Open.

programme.title: PGA AUSTRALIA /23 AUSTRALIAN OPEN - 22' Final Round
programme.desc: 22' Final Round. The final round of the Australian Open gets underway from Victoria Golf Course. Adrian Meronk finished Round 3 14-under par to Adam Scott’s 9-under, and Min Woo Lee's 8-under, so who will take out the title?

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2023: Joaquin Niemann Stuns at Aus Open
programme.desc: 2023: Joaquin Niemann Stuns at Aus Open. The Australian Golf Club: Joaquin Niemann wowed the crowds when he put on a spectacular display in storming home on the final day. The Chilean defeatedJapan’s Rikuya Hoshino in extra holes with Australia’s Min Woo Lee finishing third.

programme.title: PGA AUSTRALIA /25 AUSTRALIAN OPEN - Final Round
programme.desc: Final Round. Final round coverage of TPS South Australia begins, from Willunga Golf Course.

programme.title: Night Is Not Eternal
programme.desc: Night Is Not Eternal is a deeply personal exploration of political activism through the eyes of Chinese American filmmaker Nanfu Wang. For over seven years, Nanfu follows Rosa Maria Paya, a young Cuban activist and daughter of five-time Nobel Peace Prize nominee Oswaldo Paya, in her fight for democratic change in Cuba. Driven by her own experiences in China, Nanfu is drawn to Rosa's story and the parallels between their homelands. With intimate access, Nanfu follows Rosa's journey from the streets of Havana to rallies and conferences worldwide, capturing her transformation from a grassroots activist to an international public figure and documenting the challenges faced by activists resisting authoritarian regimes.

programme.desc: Night Is Not Eternal is a deeply personal exploration of political activism through the eyes of Chinese American filmmaker Nanfu Wang. For over seven years, Nanfu follows Rosa Maria Paya, a young Cuban activist and daughter of five-time Nobel Peace Prize nominee Oswaldo Paya, in her fight for democratic change in Cuba. Driven by her own experiences in China, Nanfu is drawn to Rosa's story and the parallels between their homelands. With intimate access, Nanfu follows Rosa's journey from the streets of Havana to rallies and conferences worldwide, capturing her transformation from a grassroots activist to an international public figure and documenting the challenges faced by activists resisting authoritarian regimes.

programme.title: Scooore! – Internationales Fußball-Magazin
programme.desc: Fußball aus der ganzen Welt mit allen Höhepunkten aus den internationalen Top-Ligen. In dem 45-minütigen Fußballmagazin werden die spektakulärsten und wichtigsten Szenen aus der niederländischen Eredivisie, der portugiesischen Liga NOS, der australischen Hyundai A-League, der japanischen J. League sowie die Copa Libertadores, Copa Sudamericana und die Copa do Brasil aus Südamerika. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: scooore Niederlande! Alle Tore
programme.desc: Vorhang auf für das Oberhaus des niederländischen Fußballs: Die Eredivisie hat auch in Deutschland viele Fans. In dieser Sendung werden die Höhepunkte der aktuellen Spieltage zusammengefasst und kompakt präsentiert. Es gibt zu jedem Spiel einen Zusammenschnitt mit den entscheidenden oder umstrittenen Szenen. Diverse Interviews mit Spielern und Trainern runden das Format ab. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: scooore Brasilien! Alle Tore
programme.desc: Die brasilianische Fußballmeisterschaft wird "Campeonato Brasileiro de Futebol" oder kurz "Brasileirão" genannt. In dem Magazin werden alle Tore der höchsten Spielklasse, der nach europäischem Muster angelegten Série A, gezeigt. Zwanzig Teams kämpfen um den Meistertitel. Die Emotionen sind unbeschreiblich und dass der brasilianische Fußball viele Stars hervorbringt, ist jedem Fußballfan bekannt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fußball: Campeonato Brasileiro
programme.desc: Wer spielt den attraktivsten Fußball bei internationalen Turnieren? Natürlich. Die Brasilianer. Zwar sind die meisten Top-Spieler bei europäischen Vereinen unter Vertrag. Doch will man die Pelés von morgen sehen, lohnt sich ein Blick auf die nationale Meisterschaft. Die Sendung zeigt die spannendsten und wichtigsten Spiele der aktuellen Saison. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fußball: Liga Profesional
programme.desc: Vorhang auf zur höchsten Spielklasse des argentinischen Fußballs: Die Primera División wurde 1985 als Nachfolger des Campeonato de Primera División und des Torneo Metropolitano gegründet. 24 Vereine sind in der Liga vertreten. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fußball: Eredivisie
programme.sub-title: Ajax Amsterdam – ADO Den Haag (13. Spieltag)
programme.desc: In der höchsten Spielklasse des niederländischen Fußballs treten derzeit 18 Mannschaften an 34 Spieltagen gegeneinander an. Dabei wird die "Eredivisie" von den Vereinen Ajax Amsterdam, dem PSV Eindhoven und Feyenoord Rotterdam dominiert. In den letzten Jahren konnten jedoch auch der AZ Alkmaar (in der Saison 2008/09) und Twente Enschede (in der Saison 2009/10) Meisterschaften feiern. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fußball: Copa Sudamericana
programme.desc: Im zweitwichtigsten Wettbewerg des südamerikanischen Vereinsfußballs waren bisher die Vereine aus Argentinien am erfolgreichsten. Titelverteidiger ist in diesem Jahr CSD Defensa Justicia aus Florencia Varela in Argentinien. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fußball: Scottish Premiership
programme.desc: Die Scottish Premiership ist seit 2013 die höchste Fußballliga in Schottland und gehört zur Scottish Professional Football League. 2013 wurde sie als Nachfolger für die Scottish Premier League gegründet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fußball: Champions League
programme.desc: 1992 wurde der seit 1955 jährlich ausgetragene Europapokal der Landesmeister stark modifiziert und fortan Champions League genannt. Die Startplätze werden gemäß der UEFA-Fünfjahreswertung an die nationalen Ligen verteilt. Ab der kommenden Spielzeit wurde der Modus abermals verändert. Die 36 (statt bisher 32) qualifizierten Teams spielen zunächst 8 Spiele (4 davon zu Hause und 4 auswärts) in der neu geschaffenen League Phase. Die Ergebnisse laufen in eine Gesamttabelle aller 36 Teams ein. Die ersten 8 Teams sind direkt für das Achtelfinale qualifiziert, die Plätze 9-24 spielen in einem KO-Playoff um die übrigen Tickets für das Achtelfinale. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fußball: 2. Bundesliga
programme.desc:
Die 2. Fußball-Bundesliga ist nach der -Bundesliga die höchste Spielklasse im deutschen Männerfußball. Im heutigen fußballerischen Volksmund bezeichnet man sie auch als „Unterhaus“, während die 1. Liga „Oberhaus“ genannt wird. Etabliert wurde die 2. Bundesliga 1974, elf Jahre nach der Gründung ihrer großen Schwester. So sollte die wirtschaftliche Kluft von Profi- und Amateurbereich überwunden werden, die zwischen der Bundesliga und den bis dahin als zweite Liga fungierenden fünf Regionalligen entstanden war.
 
An 34 Spieltagen wird um den Aufstieg bzw. Abstieg gespielt; der Meister sowie der Vize-Meister steigen automatisch in die 1. Liga auf, während sich der Drittplatzierte in zwei Relegationsspielen (Hin- und Rückspiel) mit dem 16. der 1. Bundesliga um den Aufstieg bzw. – aus Sicht des Erstligisten – Verbleib duellieren muss.
 
Anders als im Oberhaus, wo Bayern München mit 32 Titeln seit der Liga-Gründung 1963/64 den unangefochtenen Rekordmeister markiert, gibt es im Unterhaus fünf Co-Rekordmeister. Diese sind der FC Nürnberg, der SC Freiburg, der FC Köln, Arminia Bielefeld und der VfL Bochum, alle mit je vier Titeln.

programme.title: Fußball: Bundesliga
programme.sub-title: Werder Bremen – Borussia M'gladbach, Flutlicht-Freitag, 11. Spieltag
programme.desc: Der 4:0-Erfolg im Nordderby gegen den Hamburger SV war ein deutliches Ausrufezeichen der Mannschaft Daniel Thiounes. Dabei beendeten gleich zwei Spieler in Grün-Weiß ihre Durststrecke: Seit dem letzten Tor von Marco Friedl (1:0) war fast ein Jahr vergangen. Doppelpacker Justin Njinmah (3:0, 4:0) knipste unterdessen zuletzt im April beim 1:0-Auswärtssieg gegen den VfL Wolfsburg. Ungeachtet der jüngsten Erfolge bleibt die personelle Lage jedoch teilweise angespannt: Musah, Ndiaye, Stage und Topp stehen weiter auf der Invalidenliste. Hinter den Einsätzen von Agu, Alvero, Grüll und Weiser stehen noch Fragezeichen.\n \nBorussia Mönchengladbach steht dagegen nach der 0:1-Heimniederlage gegen Borussia Dortmund immer noch unter Druck und wartet weiter auf den nächsten Befreiungsschlag in der Liga. Nach wie vor steht den acht Niederlagen lediglich ein Sieg und ein Remis gegenüber. Auch die Personalsituation bleibt schwierig: Tim Kleindienst fehlte jüngst wegen eines Muskelfaserrisses, sein Comeback ist allerdings in Sicht, wenngleich ein Einsatz noch fraglich bleibt. Ebenfalls nicht zur Verfügung stehen Leopold, Leszczyński und Ullrich. Bolin und Hashioka sind angeschlagen.

programme.title: Fußball: 2. Bundesliga
programme.desc:
Die 2. Fußball-Bundesliga ist nach der -Bundesliga die höchste Spielklasse im deutschen Männerfußball. Im heutigen fußballerischen Volksmund bezeichnet man sie auch als „Unterhaus“, während die 1. Liga „Oberhaus“ genannt wird. Etabliert wurde die 2. Bundesliga 1974, elf Jahre nach der Gründung ihrer großen Schwester. So sollte die wirtschaftliche Kluft von Profi- und Amateurbereich überwunden werden, die zwischen der Bundesliga und den bis dahin als zweite Liga fungierenden fünf Regionalligen entstanden war.
 
An 34 Spieltagen wird um den Aufstieg bzw. Abstieg gespielt; der Meister sowie der Vize-Meister steigen automatisch in die 1. Liga auf, während sich der Drittplatzierte in zwei Relegationsspielen (Hin- und Rückspiel) mit dem 16. der 1. Bundesliga um den Aufstieg bzw. – aus Sicht des Erstligisten – Verbleib duellieren muss.
 
Anders als im Oberhaus, wo Bayern München mit 32 Titeln seit der Liga-Gründung 1963/64 den unangefochtenen Rekordmeister markiert, gibt es im Unterhaus fünf Co-Rekordmeister. Diese sind der FC Nürnberg, der SC Freiburg, der FC Köln, Arminia Bielefeld und der VfL Bochum, alle mit je vier Titeln.

programme.title: Fußball: Bundesliga
programme.sub-title: Hamburger SV – FC Bayern München, 11. Spieltag
programme.desc:
U. a.: Hamburger SV – FC Bayern.

Der Hamburger SV empfängt den FC Bayern nach einer deutlichen Derby-Niederlage: Beim 0:4 gegen Werder Bremen blieben die Hanseaten zum sechsten ohne Punktgewinn. Zudem verschärfte sich die Personalsituation: Linksverteidiger Miro Muheim zog sich eine Wadenverletzung zu und fällt ebenso aus wie Nicolai Remberg (Kreuzbandriss) und Yussuf Poulsen (Wadenverletzung). Auch Albert Sambi Lokonga steht nicht zur Verfügung. Auch die Münchner mussten zuletzt Rückschläge hinnehmen.
 
Unterdessen unterlag der Rekordmeister nach dem jüngsten 1:1 gegen den 1. FC Köln in der Bundesliga am Mittwoch in der Champions League beim OSC Lille mit 1:2. Besonders schwer wiegt der Ausfall von Harry Kane, der nach dem Duell mit Köln mit einem Syndesmosebandriss länger fehlen wird. Auch Manuel Neuer, Alphonso Davies und Serge Gnabry stehen nicht zur Verfügung. Ein Einsatz Michael Olise, welcher bereits gegen Lille pausieren musste, ist nach einer Fußprellung fraglich. Dafür könnte Jamal Musiala erstmals seit September wieder von Beginn an auflaufen. (Redaktionsschluss: Freitag, den 27. November).

programme.title: Fußball: Bundesliga
programme.sub-title: Highlights XXL: SC Freiburg – RB Leipzig, 11. Spieltag
programme.desc:
SC Freiburg – RB Leipzig. 
Nach sieben Spieltagen gewann Leipzig (David Raum) all seine vier Partien im eigenen Stadion bei einer Tordifferenz von 18:0 und belegte damit den ersten Platz in der Heimtabelle. Ganz unten rangierten die Sachsen hingegen in der Fremde: null Punkte, 2:11 Tore. Damit setzte RB auswärts den Negativtrend vom Saisonende 2025/26 fort, als man die letzten beiden Gastspiele in Leverkusen und beim SC Freiburg jeweils mit 1:4 verlor. 

Ab 19.30 Uhr: Hoffenheim – Augsburg, 21.30 Uhr: Dortmund – Leverkusen.

programme.title: Fußball: 2. Bundesliga
programme.desc:
Die 2. Fußball-Bundesliga ist nach der -Bundesliga die höchste Spielklasse im deutschen Männerfußball. Im heutigen fußballerischen Volksmund bezeichnet man sie auch als „Unterhaus“, während die 1. Liga „Oberhaus“ genannt wird. Etabliert wurde die 2. Bundesliga 1974, elf Jahre nach der Gründung ihrer großen Schwester. So sollte die wirtschaftliche Kluft von Profi- und Amateurbereich überwunden werden, die zwischen der Bundesliga und den bis dahin als zweite Liga fungierenden fünf Regionalligen entstanden war.
 
An 34 Spieltagen wird um den Aufstieg bzw. Abstieg gespielt; der Meister sowie der Vize-Meister steigen automatisch in die 1. Liga auf, während sich der Drittplatzierte in zwei Relegationsspielen (Hin- und Rückspiel) mit dem 16. der 1. Bundesliga um den Aufstieg bzw. – aus Sicht des Erstligisten – Verbleib duellieren muss.
 
Anders als im Oberhaus, wo Bayern München mit 32 Titeln seit der Liga-Gründung 1963/64 den unangefochtenen Rekordmeister markiert, gibt es im Unterhaus fünf Co-Rekordmeister. Diese sind der FC Nürnberg, der SC Freiburg, der FC Köln, Arminia Bielefeld und der VfL Bochum, alle mit je vier Titeln.

programme.title: Fußball: 2. Bundesliga
programme.desc:
Die 2. Fußball-Bundesliga ist nach der -Bundesliga die höchste Spielklasse im deutschen Männerfußball. Im heutigen fußballerischen Volksmund bezeichnet man sie auch als „Unterhaus“, während die 1. Liga „Oberhaus“ genannt wird. Etabliert wurde die 2. Bundesliga 1974, elf Jahre nach der Gründung ihrer großen Schwester. So sollte die wirtschaftliche Kluft von Profi- und Amateurbereich überwunden werden, die zwischen der Bundesliga und den bis dahin als zweite Liga fungierenden fünf Regionalligen entstanden war.
 
An 34 Spieltagen wird um den Aufstieg bzw. Abstieg gespielt; der Meister sowie der Vize-Meister steigen automatisch in die 1. Liga auf, während sich der Drittplatzierte in zwei Relegationsspielen (Hin- und Rückspiel) mit dem 16. der 1. Bundesliga um den Aufstieg bzw. – aus Sicht des Erstligisten – Verbleib duellieren muss.
 
Anders als im Oberhaus, wo Bayern München mit 32 Titeln seit der Liga-Gründung 1963/64 den unangefochtenen Rekordmeister markiert, gibt es im Unterhaus fünf Co-Rekordmeister. Diese sind der FC Nürnberg, der SC Freiburg, der FC Köln, Arminia Bielefeld und der VfL Bochum, alle mit je vier Titeln.

programme.title: Basketball: NBA
programme.desc: Die NBA (National Basketball Association) ist die höchste professionelle Basketballliga in Nordamerika und gilt als die beste der Welt. Sie wurde 1946 gegründet (damals als BAA – Basketball Association of America) und trägt seit 1949 nach der Fusion mit der NBL (National Basketball League) ihren heutigen Namen. \n\nDie Liga besteht aus 30 Teams, die in zwei Conferences unterteilt sind; die Eastern Conference und die Western Conference. Eine Saison besteht aus einer Regular Season (82 Spiele pro Team), den Playoffs, die Mitte April starten, und den NBA Finals, in denen im Juni der Meister gekürt wird.

programme.title: The Casebook of Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: A farmer is found dead, and for the local police inspector it's clear that the man's son, James McCarthy, should be charged with the murder. Although for Alice Turner, McCarthy's childhood friend, the matter is not a murder but a mystery, and she sends a telegram to Sherlock Holmes. As Holmes takes up the case, Alice becomes a vital source of information.

programme.title: Paul O'Grady: For the Love of Dogs
programme.desc: Paul boosts the profile of Battersea's ugliest dog, Bailey, the shih tzu with an underbite while, with Paul's help, Krystal the American bulldog finds glitz and glamour with a walk-on part in Britain's biggest soap opera `Coronation Street', and scallywag Pepe the Jack Russell hits the jackpot when he finds a posh new home.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: David and Shona alert the police to Lily's disappearance, Kit's attitude puzzles Ryan, Brody resents Idris for splashing the cash, and Fiz makes an alarming discovery in Ross' car.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Fiz angers Ross by voicing suspicions of Cassie's fate, Lisa delivers a promising update on Lily, Brody gets stopped by a police officer, and a fellow patient sets Kit thinking.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Kit's health takes a sudden and serious turn for the worse, Fiz heads to the Rovers to avoid spending time with Ross, and David and Shona's search for Lily proves fruitless.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Bethany warns Kit against blabbing their secret to Sarah, Ross gets wind of Marco's plan to escape him, and Christina learns that Lucy will be moving into Number 11.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Gary reveals Ross's true nature to a shocked Maria, Bernie blames Eva for Kit's predicament, Daniel and Adam refuse to back down, and Idris presents Carla with a business plan for the factory.

programme.title: Kavanagh QC
programme.desc: Unfortunately, Kavanagh's work has a habit of interfering with family life, so when Kavanagh becomes involved in the defence of an Oxbridge undergraduate on a rape charge, the strains on his marriage begin to re-emerge. Although the trial seems to go well, he soon learns never to take anyone or anything for granted.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Spain

programme.title: The Real Marigold Hotel
programme.desc: Britt Ekland, Duncan Bannatyne, Dame Zandra Rhodes, Paul Elliott, Henry Blofeld, John Altman, Susie Blake and Barbara Dickson arrive in India and get their first taste of the chaotic traffic on the bus to Puducherry and their new home by the sea. Although Britt struggles with the heat and Paul is struck down with an upset stomach, the group throw themselves into their new surroundings ready to embrace retired life in India.

programme.title: The Hotel Inspector
programme.desc: Alex is called to the historic Albion House in Ramsgate. The owners have invested over £1.5 million into the boutique hotel, but their lack of experience may ruin the business.

programme.title: Waterloo Road
programme.desc: In a battle of wills, Mika defies Tom as she stages an environmental protest on the new building site, while Rachel hatches a plan to stop Eddie resigning as her deputy.

programme.title: KICK 't MET
programme.desc: Tijjani Noslin deelt zijn onwaarschijnlijke levensverhaal van Subway-medewerker tot smaakmaker in de Serie A bij Lazio Roma. Hij praat openhartig over zijn moeilijke jeugd, de loodzware burn-out die hij onderweg overwon en de extreme druk van de kritische Italiaanse achterban. Tot slot legt de vastberaden aanvaller uit waarom hij zijn droom voor het Nederlands elftal nog niet opgeeft en hoe een emotioneel advies van zijn moeder hem deed besluiten om te blijven wachten op Oranje.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: After being bitten by a radioactive arachnid, student Miles Morales develops incredible abilities, and becomes a version of Spider-Man. When a super collider device opens a gateway to other dimensions, Miles crosses paths with five counterparts to stop a threat for all realities. Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Shameik Moore and Nicolas Cage.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: A clumsy teenager develops superhuman powers after a genetically engineered spider bites him. At first his fantastic skills delight him, but his elation is severely tempered by a family tragedy, prompting him to dedicate his talents to combating evil. However, he faces a baptism of fire in the form of crazed villain the Green Goblin. Comic-book superhero adventure, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Willem Dafoe, James Franco and Rosemary Harris.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Peter Parker continues his fight for justice, but unrequited love and personal worries take their toll and he is tempted to abandon his web-slinging alter ego. However, the arrival of deadly new bad guy Doctor Octopus plunges him into a race against time to save New York. Comic-book adventure sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Alfred Molina, James Franco and Rosemary Harris.

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: A sinister alien parasite brings out the web-slinging hero's darker side, filling him with thoughts of revenge on his uncle's murderer, the shape-shifting Sandman. Meanwhile, he must contend with the challenge of his best friend following in his father's villainous footsteps - and a jealous rival developing powers of his own. Superhero sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst and James Franco.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: A gifted teenager investigates the secrets hidden in his dead parents' past, leading him to a mysterious corporation and an incident that imbues him with superhuman powers. A personal tragedy drives him to use his new-found abilities to fight crime, and he is soon drawn into a deadly battle against a former colleague of his father, who has undergone a devastating transformation of his own. Superhero adventure reboot, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Rhys Ifans.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: The web-slinging hero battles a powerful new enemy when a downtrodden engineer develops lethal electrical powers, which he unleashes on those he believes have betrayed him. As if that wasn't enough to keep him busy, he faces an even greater threat when he is reunited with an unstable old friend who has been charged with a sinister mission by his dying father, leading to a series of tense confrontations that threaten to change his life for ever. Superhero adventure sequel, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Jamie Foxx and Dane DeHaan.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker balances life as an ordinary high school student with his superhero alter-ego Spider-Man, while waiting in vain to join his mentor Iron Man on a world-saving mission. Determined to prove he is ready for bigger challenges, he investigates a spree of crimes committed with advanced weapons - leading him into a battle with a ruthless winged enemy on the hunt for priceless technology. A personal tragedy drives him to use his new-found abilities to fight crime, and he is soon drawn into a deadly battle against a former colleague of his father, who has undergone a devastating transformation of his own. Superhero adventure reboot, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Rhys Ifans.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: The web-slinging hero battles a powerful new enemy when a downtrodden engineer develops lethal electrical powers, which he unleashes on those he believes have betrayed him. As if that wasn't enough to keep him busy, he faces an even greater threat when he is reunited with an unstable old friend who has been charged with a sinister mission by his dying father, leading to a series of tense confrontations that threaten to change his life for ever. Superhero adventure sequel, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Jamie Foxx and Dane DeHaan.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker balances life as an ordinary high school student with his superhero alter-ego Spider-Man, while waiting in vain to join his mentor Iron Man on a world-saving mission. Determined to prove he is ready for bigger challenges, he investigates a spree of crimes committed with advanced weapons - leading him into a battle with a ruthless winged enemy on the hunt for priceless technology. Superhero adventure, starring Tom Holland, Michael Keaton and Robert Downey Jr.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: A clumsy teenager develops superhuman powers after a genetically engineered spider bites him. At first his fantastic skills delight him, but his elation is severely tempered by a family tragedy, prompting him to dedicate his talents to combating evil. However, he faces a baptism of fire in the form of crazed villain the Green Goblin. Comic-book superhero adventure, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Willem Dafoe, James Franco and Rosemary Harris.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Peter Parker continues his fight for justice, but unrequited love and personal worries take their toll and he is tempted to abandon his web-slinging alter ego. However, the arrival of deadly new bad guy Doctor Octopus plunges him into a race against time to save New York. Comic-book adventure sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Alfred Molina, James Franco and Rosemary Harris.

programme.desc: A sinister alien parasite brings out the web-slinging hero's darker side, filling him with thoughts of revenge on his uncle's murderer, the shape-shifting Sandman. Superhero sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst and James Franco.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: An architect (Steve Martin) has a girlfriend (Dana Delany) who won't move into his house and a dizzy woman (Goldie Hawn) who won't move out.","large":"Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: A police detective (James Belushi) with a girlfriend (Mel Harris) gets stuck with a new partner, a German shepherd dog.","large":"Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.desc: Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld.","large":"A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: A deranged suitor (Mark Wahlberg) torments family and friends of a teen girl (Reese Witherspoon) with whom he is obsessed.","large":"When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. programme.desc: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.","large":"Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: A woman and her 9-year-old twin sons encounter the evil spirit of Bughuul in a rural house that's marked for death.","large":"Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a good job, a great boyfriend, and a bright future. But in three days, she's going to hell.","large":"Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.","large":"Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach.","large":"A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy

He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.desc: Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.","large":"Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: The Mexican government hires two handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) to battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.","large":"After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Mutated graboids return to feast on the residents of Perfection, threatening its new status as a tourist attraction.","large":"Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Leaving Las Vegas
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel by John O'Brien, this acclaimed drama follows alcoholic screenwriter Ben Sanderson (Nicolas Cage) as he drinks himself into oblivion in Las Vegas. When Ben meets the beautiful prostitute Sera (Elisabeth Shue), they strike up an unconventional relationship -- one where she can't ask him to curb his drinking, and he can't fault her for her job. Though they offer each other support, Ben's self-destruction threatens to eclipse their bond.

Flashing back, we learn Doniphon saved Stoddard, then a lawyer, when he was roughed up by a crew of outlaws terrorizing the town, led by Liberty Valance (Lee Marvin). programme.title: Lady of Vengeance
programme.desc: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

programme.title: Four Boys and a Gun
programme.desc: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup.

programme.title: The Big Knife
programme.desc: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way.

programme.title: Behind the Mask
programme.desc: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) tracks a killer to a clip joint and exposes a city editor's racket.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan.

programme.title: The Woman in the Window
programme.desc: With his family packed off to Maine, Professor Richard Wanley is anticipating some quiet time alone. Then he meets Alice, the model for a portrait he admires, and can't resist her offer of a drink. No sooner do they get to her place, however, than her jealous boyfriend arrives in a rage. Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime.

programme.title: The Man in the Net
programme.desc: Big city advertising artist John Hamilton (Alan Ladd) abandons his career and relocates to a sleepy Connecticut community to paint for himself instead of for a paycheck. But his erratic spouse, Linda (Carolyn Jones), quickly grows bored with her quiet new life and begins to lash out at him. After turning to the bottle, Linda begins to openly insult her husband and even accuses him of beating her. So later, when she goes missing, the locals suspect John of murder and an angry mob comes after him.

programme.desc: In this musical that features characters lip-synching to classic songs, Nick (James Gandolfini), a Queens, N.Y.-based ironworker, lives with his wife, Kitty (Susan Sarandon), and three daughters. When Nick meets a significantly younger woman, Tula (Kate Winslet), he starts an affair with her, much to the chagrin of his wife, and his life is thrown into upheaval. Kitty kicks Nick out of the house, and he is forced to make some difficult decisions.

programme.title: Billie
programme.desc: Billie (Patty Duke) is a tomboy who loves sports. When the high school track coach (Charles Lane) sees her run, he asks her to join the school team. Her inclusion in the formerly all-male team causes quite a stir, especially with her father (Jim Backus). He is typically supportive of Billie, but now he worries that her shocking behavior will cost him his bid for mayor. programme.title: The First Time

programme.title: Cul-de-Sac

Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
programme.desc: While preparations are underway for the marriage of Athenian duke Theseus (Derek Godfrey) and Amazon queen Hippolyta (Barbara Jefford), fairy king Oberon (Ian Richardson) and his tricky jester, Puck (Ian Holm), make mischief with the indiscriminate use of a powerful love potion. Lysander (David Warner) and Demetrius (Michael Jayston) both fall for Helena (Diana Rigg), raising the jealousy of Hermia (Helen Mirren), whose father is pressuring her to marry Demetrius despite Lysander's love for her.

programme.title: Hawaii
programme.desc: During the 1820s, a domineering young minister, Abner Hale (Max von Sydow), and his compassionate wife, Jerusha (Julie Andrews), embark on a dangerous sea voyage to Hawaii. Jerusha grows unhappy with her marriage and begins to fall for Rafer Hoxworth (Richard Harris), a past lover.

programme.title: Time Limit
programme.desc: Maj. Cargill (Richard Basehart) is accused of aiding his captors while held in a North Korean prison during the war and brought up on charges of treason. Col. More than a dozen witnesses are prepared to testify against Cargill, and the major himself admits his guilt. But Edwards begins to suspect that the major is innocent and covering up for someone else.

programme.title: Stolen Hours
programme.desc: Laura (Susan Hayward), an American heiress in London, is a party girl living it up, in denial of her serious illness. She rebuffs the concerns of her ex-lover (Edward Judd) and keeps her health a secret from her sister (Diane Baker). Eventually, John (Michael Craig), a handsome doctor, demands she get treatment, and Laura finally listens. Doctor and patient fall in love and move to a house on the Cornish coast. In her dying days, the restless heiress searches for humility, happiness and peace.

programme.title: A Prayer for the Dying
programme.desc: Irish Republican Army member Martin Fallon (Mickey Rourke) rigs a bomb to destroy a British army convoy, but the plan goes wrong when the trucks allow a school bus to pass. Now, Fallon wants out. He's through killing for the cause, but in order to secure safe passage to the U.S., he'll have to take one more job: eliminating rival terrorist Krasko (Stanley Beard). Unfortunately, a priest (Bob Hoskins) complicates matters by witnessing the hit, but Fallon believes he knows how to keep him silent.

programme.title: The Boss

Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has.

A series of beach-themed films would follow the blueprint set by this one, which hinges on romantic rivalries, rugged motorcyclists, an attempted crime and plenty of handsome people.

programme.title: Cult of the Damned
programme.desc: An unscrupulous rock star brings decadence and debauchery to a naive young woman's wealthy household.

programme.title: High Spirits
programme.desc: Irish hotelier Peter Plunkett attempts to fill the chronic vacancies at his castle by launching an advertising campaign that wrongly portrays the property as haunted. Unfortunately, he fails to scare a single American tourist with his hokey and dreadfully unconvincing effects. When two actual ghosts, Mary and Martin, show up to add some authenticity, they end up falling for two guests, Sharon and Jack.

programme.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
programme.desc: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: Windprints
programme.desc: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

programme.title: For Us, the Living
programme.desc: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened.

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

programme.title: Bojangles
programme.desc: Based on the life of tap-dancing legend Bill Robinson -- also known as Mr. Bojangles -- the film follows Robinson as he climbs his way up the entertainment ladder from lowly vaudeville performer to one of the greatest black entertainers of his time. However, despite Robinson's meteoric rise and the support of his loyal agent, Marty Forkins, his compulsive gambling and love of women keep him from enjoying the success his talents have earned him.

programme.title: Convicts
programme.desc: In 1902, Soll (Robert Duvall), a Texas plantation owner who depends on convict labor to keep his farm running, takes a liking to Horace (Lukas Haas), a young boy who works the fields to raise money for his deceased father's headstone. Soll, however, is aging and sinking into senility, making the possibility of Horace ever getting his pay increasingly unlikely. Meanwhile, Soll's relationships with the African-American cons working the farm are complex and informed by both racism and compassion.

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Richard "Cochise" Morris (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs), a local basketball hero, and Leroy "Preach" Jackson (Glynn Turman), who dreams of a career in writing, are likable Chicago high school students in Chicago in the 1960s. They're into hanging out with friends, pretty girls and the Motown sounds so popular during the era. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry.

programme.title: Youngblood
programme.desc: An angry Vietnam veteran (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs) leads a Los Angeles street gang in a war on drug dealers.

programme.title: Born Wild
programme.desc: Relocating from California to a small town in Arizona, young Tony (Tom Nardini) arrives at a high school simmering with racial tension. While Tony attempts to cool the conflicts between the local Latino gang and a white group led by the tough-talking Bruce (David Macklin), his efforts aren't met with much regard. With even the school's teachers openly taking sides, it seems that little can be done to avoid an inevitable explosion of hate-fueled violence.

programme.title: Take a Giant Step
programme.desc: After African-American teenager Spence Scott (Johnny Nash) gets expelled from his private school for arguing with a teacher, he turns to his grandmother (Estelle Hemsley) for advice. Spence, who lives in a genteel white area and has mostly white friends, feels like an outsider. He visits a bar in a black neighborhood, where he meets a few prostitutes, which doesn't help. Eventually, Spence starts a friendship with the housekeeper, Christine (Ruby Dee), who tells him her own difficult story.

programme.title: Body and Soul
programme.desc: Leon Johnson (Leon Isaac Kennedy) is a boxer who plans to study medicine, but, with his ailing sister, Kelly (Nikki Swassy), in need of costly care, he decides to earn a living in the ring. His rise is rapid, but Leon's newly extravagant lifestyle threatens his relationship with girlfriend Julie (Jayne Kennedy). As Leon approaches the sport's highest echelons, he faces increasingly tough decisions that test his loyalty to his family and himself.

programme.title: Holiday Heart
programme.desc: After losing his police officer lover, Christian drag queen Holiday Heart (Ving Rhames) meets 12-year-old Niki (Jessika Quynn Reynolds) and her drug-addicted mother, Wanda (Alfre Woodard). Heart finds relief from heartache and a renewed sense of purpose when he steps in as a father figure to Niki and welcomes the two women into his life. But when Wanda becomes romantically involved with her drug dealer, Silas, it may endanger Niki and threaten to destroy the makeshift family.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Despite being far from home, American jazz musicians Ram Bowen (Paul Newman) and Eddie Cook (Sidney Poitier) are content living and working in Paris. Ram knows it's the best place for him to develop his musical reputation, and Eddie is far away from the racism that once greeted him on a regular basis. But after meeting and falling in love with American tourists Lillian (Joanne Woodward) and Connie (Diahann Carroll), the pair must decide whether their artistic integrity is worth abandoning.

programme.title: A Life of Sin
programme.desc: A South American reporter (Raul Julia) investigates the life of an impoverished Caribbean peasant girl who became a world-famous madam (Miriam Colon).

programme.title: Fires Within
programme.desc: In 1982, Cuban political activist Nestor (Jimmy Smits) is ripped from the arms of his loving wife, Isabel (Greta Scacchi), and thrown in jail for dissidence. Frightened, Isabel flees with their daughter by sea to America. Off the coast of Florida, she meets Sam (Vincent D'Onofrio), a kind fisherman who sees them safely to Miami's Little Havana. Eight years later, Isabel is happy in the arms of Sam -- until a recently freed Nestor reaches Miami in hope of a romantic reunion.

programme.title: Halliday Brand
programme.desc: As his father, Big Dan (Ward Bond), lies dying, estranged son Daniel Halliday (Joseph Cotten) returns to the family cattle ranch and recalls why he left home. Years before, Big Dan discovered that his daughter, Martha (Betsy Blair), was in love with Native American ranch hand Jivaro (Christopher Dark) and had the young man arrested on false charges. Outraged, Daniel left home and teamed with Jivaro's beautiful sister (Viveca Lindfors) and vengeful father (Jay C. Flippen) for retribution.

programme.title: More Dead Than Alive
programme.desc: An outlaw responsible for many deaths, Cain is released from prison after years behind bars. Despite his earlier wicked ways, Cain has made a real effort to reform and just wants to be left in peace. Unfortunately, his reputation limits his employment options, and he's left with no choice except becoming a performer in a Wild West show. Working for promoter Dan Ruffalo, Cain attempts to lead a relatively quiet life, but other gunslingers are still out to get him.

programme.title: Gun Fever
programme.desc: After growing up living a life of crime, outlaw Sam Weller (John Lupton) decides to go straight, but neither Sam's father, Trench (Aaron Saxon), nor his thieving cohort, Charlie Whitman (Norman Frederic), take the news well. After Sam invests in a way station with his friend, Luke Ram (Mark Stevens), Trench and Whitman convince a band of Sioux warriors to attack the station. Although Simon eventually forges a peace agreement with the Sioux, a final battle with Trench looms on the horizon.

programme.title: The Law Rides Again
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) use a convict (Jack LaRue) to trap a crooked Indian agent.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: When Bat arrives at a mining town in Bonanza, Colo., to collect $20,000 in earnings from a cattle drive, he discovers the town believes him dead and gave his money to a woman claiming to be his widow.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: The territorial administrator seeks Bat's help in stemming a crime wave in Cheyenne.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Liz Dothan persuades Sam Wade to place her jewelry overnight in the Wells Fargo safe, and remembers the combination as she watches him open it; Hollister's sharp mind and keen observations help him solve the subsequent $20,000 theft.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Jonas Bell is killed in a scuffle with Hollister after a bank clerk is murdered; siblings Noah and Lady Bell conspire to avenge their father targeting Hollister.

programme.title: The Alamo: Thirteen Days to Glory
programme.desc: In 1836, Jim Bowie, Davy Crockett and the Texas rebels make a heroic last stand at the Alamo against the Mexican army of several thousand men led by General Santa Anna.

programme.title: Blood Red
programme.desc: In the 1890s California, Sicilian winemakers battle with a railroad tycoon over control of the land. William Berrigan will stop at nothing to get what he wants -- a train track running through the valley. Standing in his way is the Collogero family: father Sebastian, son Marco, and daughter Maria. But Berrigan makes a misjudgment when he orders the death of Sebastian, which launches a blood war in the vine-strangled hills.

programme.title: Rebel in Town
programme.desc: Bedloe Mason and his four sons ride into an Arizona outpost after robbing a bank. When they hear a gun go off behind them, one son immediately turns around and shoots to kill. But his victim turns out to be a young boy with a toy gun, so the Masons hightail it out of town, save for Bedloe's son Gray, who feels guilty and stays to see the kid buried. Yet Gray's presence only stirs up more trouble as the child's father, John, looks for violent revenge.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle.

programme.title: A Dog's Best Friend
programme.desc: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd.

programme.title: Belle of the Yukon

John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman.

programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace.

programme.title: Revolt at Fort Laramie
programme.desc: At the dawn of the American Civil War, tensions begin to mount between Northern and Southern sympathizers stationed at Fort Laramie in Wyoming. The Southern soldiers, led by Maj. Seth Bradner (John Dehner), leave Fort Laramie to join the Confederate cause. But when Bradner is captured by a fortune-seeking Sioux tribe en route to Texas, it's up to Capt. James Tenslip (Gregg Palmer), a Northerner who has fallen for Bradner's niece Melissa (Frances Helm), to save him.

programme.title: Frontier Uprising
programme.desc: A wagon train heads for California unaware that local Indians have sided with Mexico against the United States.

programme.title: Fort Defiance
programme.desc: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). After saving Johnny's blind brother, Ned (Peter Graves), from being trampled by a horse, Ben accompanies him to the family ranch. While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny.

programme.title: Drango
programme.desc: With the Civil War still a fresh memory, Maj. Clint Drango of the Union Army must restore order to Kennesaw Pass, Georgia. However, even with the trusty Capt. Marc Banning along, he faces a distrustful town, as well as former Confederates led by the manipulative Clay Allen. A high-stakes battle of wills ensues as Drango, who hides a dark secret related to the town, must win the people's support to prevent the Union Army from intervening.

programme.title: Geronimo
programme.desc: Apache leader Geronimo (Chuck Connors) tires of battling American and Mexican troops, and decides to surrender his meager tribe. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger).

programme.title: Revolt at Fort Laramie
programme.desc: At the dawn of the American Civil War, tensions begin to mount between Northern and Southern sympathizers stationed at Fort Laramie in Wyoming. The Southern soldiers, led by Maj. Seth Bradner (John Dehner), leave Fort Laramie to join the Confederate cause. But when Bradner is captured by a fortune-seeking Sioux tribe en route to Texas, it's up to Capt. James Tenslip (Gregg Palmer), a Northerner who has fallen for Bradner's niece Melissa (Frances Helm), to save him.

programme.title: Frontier Uprising
programme.desc: A wagon train heads for California unaware that local Indians have sided with Mexico against the United States.

programme.title: Fort Defiance
programme.desc: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). After saving Johnny's blind brother, Ned (Peter Graves), from being trampled by a horse, Ben accompanies him to the family ranch. While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny.

programme.title: Drango
programme.desc: With the Civil War still a fresh memory, Maj. Clint Drango of the Union Army must restore order to Kennesaw Pass, Georgia. However, even with the trusty Capt. Marc Banning along, he faces a distrustful town, as well as former Confederates led by the manipulative Clay Allen. A high-stakes battle of wills ensues as Drango, who hides a dark secret related to the town, must win the people's support to prevent the Union Army from intervening.

programme.title: Fort Yuma

programme.title: Bat Masterson

programme.title: Toughest Gun in Tombstone
programme.desc: Before initiating an undercover investigation in Tombstone, Ariz., Capt. Matt Sloane (George Montgomery) sets out to build a reputation for himself as a ruthless man. Sloane distributes "wanted" circulars describing his supposed criminal exploits; drops off his young son, Terry (Scotty Morrow), with a friend; and joins a vicious gang headed up by his target: reckless outlaw Johnny Ringo (Jim Davis). As Sloane works his way into Ringo's inner circle, Terry flees home in search of his father.

programme.title: Gunfighters of Abilene
programme.desc: A gunslinger (Buster Crabbe) goes after the land baron (Barton MacLane) who framed and killed his brother.

programme.title: Gun Fight
programme.desc: After finishing a stint as a cavalryman, Wayne Santley (James Brown) is looking forward to taking a job on his brother's ranch. While traveling to see his sibling, he helps entertainer Nora (Joan Staley) out of a sticky situation with an aggressive suitor, and promptly falls in love with her. But when he and Nora finally meet up with Wayne's brother, Brad (Gregg Palmer), they learn the ranch is just a front for a crime ring. Wayne is appalled, leading to a feud between the brothers.

programme.title: Five Guns to Tombstone
programme.desc: Billy (James Brown) is an ex-bandit who has gone clean. His brother Matt (Robert Karnes) is a thug who just busted out of jail. Matt wants his brother to join his gang, but Billy refuses -- that is, until Matt threatens to pin a crime on him. Billy reluctantly rides with the crooks, but a brotherly brawl breaks out and Matt is killed in the scuffle that he instigated, while his adolescent son, Ted (John Wilder), looks on. Unaware of his dad's dastardly side, Ted sics the law on Billy.

programme.title: Gunslinger
programme.desc: When her marshal husband is murdered, Rose Hood (Beverly Garland) slides on his holster and takes his dangerous duty. This riles local brothel madam Erica Page (Allison Hayes), so she employs Cane Miro (John Ireland), a hired gun with an axe to grind, to bring an end to Hood and her brand of justice. When Miro meets Hood, though, he is struck by her strength and beauty. Still, the passion that begins to burn between them will not prevent their inevitable showdown.

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Melody Jones (Gary Cooper) is a laid-back cowboy who gets lost on the trail and ends up in the small town of Payneville. Seeing the initials "MJ" on his saddle, the people of Payneville mistake Jones for the treacherous bandit Monte Jarrad (Dan Duryea), and they nearly kill him before he is rescued by Cherry de Longpre (Loretta Young). Grateful for her help, Jones falls for de Cherry, not knowing that she is Jarrad's girl and that she plans on using him to help Jarrad elude capture.

programme.title: Terror in a Texas Town
programme.desc: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice.

programme.desc: Reformed ex-convict Brock Mitchell (John Derek) completes a prison sentence for shooting a man in a desperate act of self-defense and travels to the ranch run by his brother, Tracy (Nick Adams). programme.title: The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: As the winter of 1867 approaches, Denver inhabitants led by chronic drunk Oracle Jones (Donald Pleasence), who has visions when inebriated, realize with horror that their supply of whiskey will run out before the snows melt. Oracle devises a plan to bring cases of whiskey from a distillery, but is thwarted at every turn. A temperance leader (Lee Remick), three Sioux Indians, and the U.S. Cavalry become interested in the shipment, and a sandstorm and quicksand add to the difficulties.

Life is good at the small town restaurant until two corporate execs bring news that Deeds is about to be rolling in a different kind of dough. A long-lost relative has left him an inheritance of 40 billion dollars along with the largest media company in the world. It's a fish out of water, rags-to-riches story that has local tabloid reporters salivating.

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Song vs. Figueiredo - Main
programme.desc: UFC makes its fifth appearance in Macau, China and second at Galaxy Arena on Saturday, May 30 with a Fight Night event headlined by “The Kung Fu Kid” Song Yadong facing off with Deiveson “Deus da Guerra” Figueiredo. Still just 28 years old, the Chinese standout Song has won each of his last three main event assignments while amassing an 11-4-1 record inside the Octagon with wins over Marlon “Chito” Vera, Marlon Moraes, and Henry Cejudo. A two-time UFC flyweight titleholder, Figueiredo has been a Top 10 mainstay since moving to bantamweight, facing a non-stop slate of tough competition including former champ Cody Garbrandt, current champ Petr Yan, and perennial contenders like Vera, Cory Sandhagen, and Umar Nurmagomedov.
